title: The boy at the grill, alone
logline: Gully's son, twelve, at the grill by himself, from behind, on the stool, the tongs, the smoke, and Gully's back at the far end of the dock not watching. Two backs, apart. The page measures the distance.

panels.composition: A boy of twelve from behind on a stool at a grill with tongs and smoke, and at the far end of the dock a heavy gray man's back not watching, the bay.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a boy of twelve seen from behind on a stool at a grill with tongs and rising smoke, a heavy gray-haired man's back at the far end of a dock not watching, a bay beyond, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
